rule dac_gh_0026 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: SSH key added to privileged org member account - public_key.create for admin members"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0026"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1098"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "public_key.create" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.add_public_key" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
